description: Election Commission - Declare that V. Sivakadadsam as a Member of the Point Pedro Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Point Pedro Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
